summary: Even after retaining scalar-fiber probability mass, the mixed norm E||p_{Q3|Q'}||_infinity is not universally bounded. A single explicit n=4 cap-one product law with fixed spectrum {1,1,1,-1} makes this expectation infinite. This does not refute QFORM: the large conditional peaks move to different translated full-output locations. A viable scalar-coarea proof must keep p_{Q3|Q'=b}(y-b) inside the b-integral before taking any supremum.
